headline: DEWALT ownership, professional cleaning equipment, licensees and supply chain
description: A source-backed profile of DEWALT's Stanley Black & Decker ownership, professional dust-management and outdoor portfolio, licensed products and model-level sourcing checks.

ownership.summary: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. owns DEWALT. Black & Decker acquired DeWalt in 1960, and the 2010 merger of The Stanley Works and The Black & Decker Corporation placed the brand inside today's listed Stanley Black & Decker group. BLACK+DECKER and CRAFTSMAN are sibling brands, not DEWALT's parents.

leadership.name: Raymond E. DeWalt
leadership.context: Stanley Black & Decker's brand history credits Raymond DeWalt with forming the DEWALT Products Company in 1924.

productPortfolio.name: Dust management and wet-dry vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: Professional dust extractors, wet-dry vacuums and jobsite collection systems support construction and industrial cleaning.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm filtration class, tool activation, electrical rating, accessories, compliance and service route by model.

productPortfolio.name: Cordless hand and stick vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: Battery-powered cleaning products extend the DEWALT system into portable jobsite and workshop cleanup.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Battery platform compatibility, included pack, runtime and warranty depend on the exact regional SKU.

productPortfolio.name: Pressure washers
productPortfolio.positioning: Electric and engine-driven pressure washers cover residential, professional and licensed-product applications.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Some documented models use licensed manufacturers, so buyers must verify the product company and warranty route.

productPortfolio.name: Professional power tools and outdoor equipment
productPortfolio.positioning: Cordless tools, storage, accessories and outdoor equipment form the wider platform around cleaning products.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Common brand ownership does not guarantee battery, accessory, parts or service compatibility across every line.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Stanley Black & Decker reports manufacturing and sourcing operations across the United States, other Americas, Europe and Asia.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Use the exact model label, declaration, certification and shipment records to identify origin.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The DXPW1200E manual says the pressure washer was manufactured under licence for DEWALT Industrial Tool Co. by FNA Group.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not generalize the FNA relationship beyond the models covered by the official manual.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Supplier disclosures can show DEWALT authorization or customer relationships without mapping an exact SKU to a factory.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the purchase order, audit, declaration and factory record to the contracted SKU and batch.

marketsChannels.evidence: DEWALT is a priority global professional brand in Stanley Black & Decker's Tools & Outdoor segment.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the regional operating company and authorized channel for the destination market.

marketsChannels.evidence: Home Depot and Lowe's are major Stanley Black & Decker customers, alongside professional distributors and online channels.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: A retailer is a channel, not the brand owner; verify seller authorization and warranty eligibility.

marketsChannels.evidence: UK, Ireland, Australia, Canada and other markets use named regional Stanley Black & Decker entities and local terms.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Use the legal name on the local contract, invoice, importer label and warranty policy.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: DEWALT carries a powerful professional-tool reputation into jobsite vacuums, dust management and pressure washing, reinforced by a broad battery and dealer ecosystem. Its main diligence challenge is operating complexity: group-owned, supplier-made and licensed products can use different manufacturers and warranty routes.
